messages.content: Explain, in precise technical language, why a C++ compiler flag that changes only preprocessor macro conformance (/Zc:preprocessor on MSVC) can affect the compilation of CUDA translation units that include CCCL headers, and describe what a bitwise-identical greedy decoding comparison between two builds proves about the generated code. First work the argument out in your thinking. Then give the explanation, and end with one sentence that summarizes the argument.
